tables.title: Data block gap hardware flow control behavior
tables.text_helper: Table 229, "Data block gap hardware flow control behavior", in section 30.7.2 (Block gap hardware flow control) on page 1426. Columns: Condition (HWFC_EN = 1 and BUSSPEED = 1), Description. 2 data row(s).

rows:
New block transfer is only started when the FIFO has 
enough data (TX mode) / free space (RX mode) up to or 
more than the THR threshold.
Note: Data flow control is guaranteed. A block transfer is 
only stared when enough data for at least one block 
is available / free in the FIFO

New block transfer is only started when the FIFO has 
enough data (TX mode) / free space (RX mode) up to or 
more than the THR threshold.
Note: Data flow control is not guaranteed. A block transfer 
is started even when not enough data for one block 
is available / free in the FIFO. The threshold can be 
used to trade off transfer latency / throughput versus 
FIFO underrun / overrun risk.
